requirements.","source_section":"MG-4.3-003"}]}],"implementation_notes":"NIST AI 600-1 is explicitly voluntary guidance serving as a companion to AI RMF 1.0, developed per EO 14110 Section 4.1(a)(i)(A). It provides suggested (not required) actions organized by AI RMF functions (Govern, Map, Measure, Manage). Four primary GAI considerations are addressed: Governance, Pre-Deployment Testing, Content Provenance, and Incident Disclosure. The document covers general-purpose/foundation models broadly across sectors. No binding enforcement mechanisms are created by this document itself; references to mandatory reporting (e.g., HIPAA) point to pre-existing external legal obligations rather than new requirements from this profile.","confidence":0.95}
